import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"].copy()
    order_items = db["order_items"].copy()
    reviews = db["reviews"].copy()
    payments = db["payments"].copy()

    for col in ["order_purchase_timestamp", "order_approved_at",
                "order_delivered_carrier_date", "order_delivered_customer_date",
                "order_estimated_delivery_date"]:
        if col in orders.columns:
            orders[col] = pd.to_datetime(orders[col], errors="coerce")
    for col in ["shipping_limit_date", "ts"]:
        if col in order_items.columns:
            order_items[col] = pd.to_datetime(order_items[col], errors="coerce")
    for col in ["review_creation_date", "review_answer_timestamp"]:
        if col in reviews.columns:
            reviews[col] = pd.to_datetime(reviews[col], errors="coerce")
    if "ts" in payments.columns:
        payments["ts"] = pd.to_datetime(payments["ts"], errors="coerce")

    base_date = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)

    # --- История: только события, которые уже произошли к seed_time ---
    order_items_hist = order_items[order_items["ts"] < base_date].copy()

    # Отзывы: учитываем только те, что уже созданы к seed_time
    reviews_hist = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < base_date].copy()
    review_score_by_order = reviews_hist.groupby("order_id")["review_score"].agg(["mean", "count"])
    review_score_by_order.columns = ["order_review_mean", "order_review_count"]

    # Платежи: только те, что известны к seed_time
    payments_hist = payments[payments["ts"] < base_date].copy()
    payments_agg = payments_hist.groupby("order_id", as_index=False).agg({
        "payment_value": "sum",
        "payment_installments": "max"
    }).rename(columns={
        "payment_value": "total_payment_value",
        "payment_installments": "max_installments"
    })

    # Заказы: статус и оценки доставки известны только если событие уже произошло
    orders_hist = orders[orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < base_date].copy()
    # Доставка считается состоявшейся только если дата доставки <= seed_time
    delivered_known = orders_hist[
        orders_hist["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna()
        & (orders_hist["order_delivered_customer_date"] <= base_date)
    ].copy()
    delivered_known["delivery_days"] = (
        delivered_known["order_delivered_customer_date"]
        - delivered_known["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
    ).dt.days
    delivered_known["delivery_delay_days"] = (
        delivered_known["order_delivered_customer_date"]
        - delivered_known["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.days
    delivery_stats = delivered_known.groupby("order_id").agg({
        "delivery_days": "first",
        "delivery_delay_days": "first",
    })

    # Собираем позиции с заказами (только заказы, купленные до seed_time)
    order_items_full = pd.merge(
        order_items_hist,
        orders_hist[["order_id", "order_status", "order_purchase_timestamp",
                     "order_estimated_delivery_date"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    order_items_full = pd.merge(
        order_items_full, review_score_by_order, on="order_id", how="left"
    )
    order_items_full = pd.merge(
        order_items_full, payments_agg, on="order_id", how="left"
    )
    order_items_full = pd.merge(
        order_items_full, delivery_stats, on="order_id", how="left"
    )

    # --- Временные окна ---
    time_windows = [30, 90, 180, 9999]
    features_list = []

    for window in time_windows:
        window_start = base_date - pd.Timedelta(days=window)
        mask = (order_items_full["ts"] >= window_start) & (order_items_full["ts"] < base_date)
        window_data = order_items_full[mask]

        agg_dict = {
            "order_id": "nunique",
            "order_item_id": "count",
            "price": ["mean", "sum", "std", "max"],
            "freight_value": ["mean", "sum"],
            "order_review_mean": ["mean", "std", "count"],
            "total_payment_value": "sum",
            "max_installments": "mean",
        }
        product_agg = window_data.groupby("product_id").agg(agg_dict)
        product_agg.columns = [f"{c[0]}_{c[1]}_w{window}" for c in product_agg.columns]
        features_list.append(product_agg)

    all_features = pd.concat(features_list, axis=1, join="outer")
    all_features = all_features.loc[:, ~all_features.columns.duplicated()]

    # --- Признаки давности ---
    last_sale = order_items_hist.groupby("product_id")["ts"].max()
    all_features["days_since_last_sale"] = (base_date - last_sale).dt.days
    first_sale = order_items_hist.groupby("product_id")["ts"].min()
    all_features["days_since_first_sale"] = (base_date - first_sale).dt.days

    # Число уникальных продавцов и продавец с макс. продажами (за 180 дней)
    w180_start = base_date - pd.Timedelta(days=180)
    w180 = order_items_full[
        (order_items_full["ts"] >= w180_start) & (order_items_full["ts"] < base_date)
    ]
    seller_stats = w180.groupby("product_id").agg(
        n_sellers_w180=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        n_items_w180=("order_item_id", "count"),
    )
    all_features = all_features.join(seller_stats, how="outer")

    # Тренд: продажи за последние 30 дней vs предыдущие 30 дней
    cur_start = base_date - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    prev_start = base_date - pd.Timedelta(days=60)
    cur_cnt = order_items_full[
        (order_items_full["ts"] >= cur_start) & (order_items_full["ts"] < base_date)
    ].groupby("product_id")["order_item_id"].count()
    prev_cnt = order_items_full[
        (order_items_full["ts"] >= prev_start) & (order_items_full["ts"] < cur_start)
    ].groupby("product_id")["order_item_id"].count()
    all_features["sales_last30"] = cur_cnt
    all_features["sales_prev30"] = prev_cnt
    all_features["sales_trend_30"] = cur_cnt - prev_cnt

    # --- Признаки доставки: только по заказам, доставленным ДО seed_time ---
    delivered_items = order_items_full[
        order_items_full["delivery_days"].notna()
    ]
    delivery_prod = delivered_items.groupby("product_id").agg(
        delivery_vs_est_mean=("delivery_days", "mean"),
        delivery_vs_est_std=("delivery_days", "std"),
        delivery_delay_mean=("delivery_delay_days", "mean"),
        n_delivered=("delivery_days", "count"),
    )
    all_features = all_features.join(delivery_prod, how="outer")

    # Доля доставленных заказов среди заказов, купленных за 90 дней
    w90_start = base_date - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    w90 = order_items_full[
        (order_items_full["ts"] >= w90_start) & (order_items_full["ts"] < base_date)
    ]
    del_share = w90.groupby("product_id")["delivery_days"].apply(
        lambda s: s.notna().mean() if len(s) > 0 else np.nan
    )
    del_share.name = "delivered_share_w90"
    all_features = all_features.join(del_share, how="outer")

    # --- Флаги и заполнение пропусков ---
    has_history = order_items_hist.groupby("product_id").size()
    all_features["is_new_product"] = (
        all_features.index.map(lambda p: 0 if p in has_history.index else 1)
    ).astype(int)

    # Доля товара в общей выручке за 90 дней
    if "price_sum_w90" in all_features.columns:
        total_rev_90 = all_features["price_sum_w90"].sum()
        if total_rev_90 and total_rev_90 > 0:
            all_features["revenue_share_w90"] = all_features["price_sum_w90"] / total_rev_90
        else:
            all_features["revenue_share_w90"] = 0.0

    result_df = all_features.reindex(entity_ids)

    if "is_new_product" in result_df.columns:
        result_df["is_new_product"] = result_df["is_new_product"].fillna(1)
    else:
        result_df["is_new_product"] = 1

    result_df = result_df.fillna(0)
    result_df = result_df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number])

    return result_df
